translations.web: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
translations.bsb: “What is written in the Law?” Jesus replied. “How do you read it?”
translations.kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
translations.asv: And he said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
